svg.text: Stage 2 · Fast Start — Jump Straight to 2-Letter Pairs
Boggle words need 3+ letters, so walking 1-letter paths is wasted work. Look up every touching pair in a tiny 1.7 KB table.
Each square connects to its touching neighbors
One table read tells us if a pair starts real words

g.text: Real words start with "CA" — jump straight to page #45!
No words start with "CQ" — thrown away immediately.
Entire table is just 1.7 KB (fits in L1 CPU cache)

svg.text: Each surviving start fits in one 64-bit ticket

g.text: Ready to expand into 3-letter words in Stage 3 →

svg.text: Skips an entire level of search, drops dead 2-letter prefixes early, and stores each state in 1 write.
